# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- The Patat repository (github.com/SeppVloo/Patat) belongs to Git user SeppVloo; pushes should use that account.
- Always commit and push changes after completing a task (no need to ask).
- Keep SPEC.md updated with every new or changed spec (including changelog), in the same commit as the code.
- The app must have a short in-app help ("❓ Hoe werkt het?") explaining how to use and set it up; keep it in sync with the rules.

## Terminal Usage
- Never wait longer than 30 seconds for terminal output; use short waits and poll background commands instead.
